functionalGroups.title: Development workflows
functionalGroups.canonical: Use brainstorming for open-ended discovery, then route development work by complexity: ai-pair-programmer for 0-30, user choice for 31-60, and sdd-dev-workflow for 61-100 before implementation.
functionalGroups.recommendation: Score requirement uncertainty, impact scope, contract and data risk, external coordination, and validation difficulty. Use app-scanner for multi-application context. sdd-dev-workflow must inspect code and stop at tasks unless implementation is explicitly requested.

functionalGroups.title: Review and test design
functionalGroups.canonical: Use the narrowest review skill matching the request.
functionalGroups.recommendation: Reserve full-review for combined reports and team-cr for meeting preparation.
